entries.scope: Default model sunlight initialization
entries.limits: Live renderer builds and uses the exact default first table; browser cache is static and does not establish the full native initializer's global state and companion table.

entries.scope: Allocate an effect into the first free terrain-light slot and refresh its footprint
entries.limits: Browser effects use a fixed 50-slot pool, derive its count and refresh on successful registration. The original additionally sets owner-object flag 0x04000000, which the live browser effect adapter does not maintain.

entries.scope: Refresh dynamic terrain-light contributions
entries.limits: Live effect-owned lights update wrapped footprints; desktop caller forces enable true and adapts original person owners to browser effects, not complete native ownership and gating.

entries.scope: Compute the first 1,024-entry sunlight lookup table
entries.limits: Live renderer consumes cached first table and oracle compares 33 inputs; original second table and rotating live sunlight state are not in this mapping.

entries.scope: Default next state for a person model
entries.limits: Model-table lookup and the level-flag/model-7 override only; other initialization is separate.

entries.scope: Apply occupied-cell building footprint map writes
entries.limits: Live non-plan footprint updates owner, flags, low slot bits and shade; production supplies a no-op refresh callback, so original texture refresh dispatch is not established.

entries.scope: Update scenery shadow on the occupied shape cells
entries.limits: Live scenery bookkeeping supplies a no-op texture request callback; this maps shape/shade updates but not the original texture request side effect.

entries.scope: Transform building map anchor to its rotated model origin
entries.limits: Browser computes and consumes wrapped XY and samples resulting foundation height through callers; native function also writes cell-list membership and clears a native object flag.

entries.scope: Grade supported building-footprint terrain including dock edges
entries.limits: Live committed site grading writes the four vertices of occupied tiles, follows native minimum/average gates and dock edge lowering, and requests an affected-cell refresh; native imported models/rules within tested shape domain.

entries.scope: Compute six supported building socket positions and offsets
entries.limits: Native original objects and four orientations in direct probe; browser returns terrain-independent height offset and live effects/props apply terrain separately. No claim about actor entry state.

entries.scope: Drive hut birth clocks, birth placement, and cues
entries.limits: Live spawn, sockets, redirect, flash and human cue; world turn retains browser route adapter for newborn home/state ownership, so not full native lifecycle.

entries.scope: Drive occupied-hut maturity and upgrade admission
entries.limits: Direct oracle covers signed clocks and wood query decisions; live fetch work, state changes, and upgrade scheduling still go through browser actor adapters.

entries.scope: Morph point interpolation
entries.limits: Native coordinate arithmetic is compared; does not establish the complete original model and scheduler behavior.

entries.scope: Quantize a model triangle cross product to its native face normal
entries.limits: Direct oracle covers 4,096 inputs including degenerate triangles; live renderer uses the quantized native 32-by-32 normal table. Not a whole-renderer parity claim.

entries.scope: Compute even, signed-byte-bounded view-transition timing
entries.limits: Direct oracle covers 60 original frame-rate/scale combinations; live browser uses its fixed 24 Hz transition scheduler and not all original frame-rate inputs.

entries.scope: Step the browser's native integer view field transition
entries.limits: Oracle compares 13 rendered fields across the ten preset resolutions; bound to discrete browser steps, not interpolated presentation or renderer frame scheduling.

entries.scope: Search a person route using the original candidate and compacted path model
entries.limits: Real gameplay planner composes route geometry, smoothing and output; object admission and vehicle/cell consumers are browser adapters, not native-wide identity.

entries.scope: Prepare the original overlapping path-candidate buffers
entries.limits: Live planner prepare callback; native harness compares defined buffers and shared state including retry-four alias. Bounds exclude outer route ownership.

entries.scope: Choose and write a native path-retry candidate
entries.limits: Direct comparison includes all tested candidate coordinate writes and overlapping neighborhood layout; live planner chooses with its existing path state.

entries.scope: Solve a live person's path with both native obstacle walkers
entries.limits: Tracked oracle exercises full route buffers, but browser supplies its own building access, boat admission and disembark effects; cross-model search identity is not fully established.

entries.scope: Collect native path route bytes and truncation result
entries.limits: Live planner collects its requested first result slot into the native-shaped route buffer; native collector proof is scoped to supported current queue slots and not the wider planner.

entries.scope: Smooth a live native-shaped route through repeated four-node probes
entries.limits: Direct oracle compares defined route writes and probe effects; live planner calls it with start slot zero and solver also uses it for local obstacle paths. Outer collision parity separate.

entries.scope: Probe whether a staged native path segment is clear
entries.limits: Live smoothing uses the line and quarter-cell probe path; bounded to supplied walk-mask/collision responses and not the ownership of original path actors.

entries.scope: Initialize native fixed-point straight-path line state
entries.limits: Direct 1,024-case geometry mode and live solver plus smoothing consumers; input is native route coordinates and not browser UI coordinate projection.

entries.scope: Probe the next route step against native caches and occupancy
entries.limits: Native-order quarter-cell probing and cache behavior live; building and boat callbacks use browser actor/ownership adapters, not complete original native input identities.

entries.scope: Step one native-style path obstacle walker
entries.limits: Live solver steps both sides; native oracle validates route buffers and supplied consumers in 1,024 cases for this mode. Bounded to the staged geometry and consumer responses.

entries.scope: Merge an obstacle detour into the main native-shaped route buffer
entries.limits: Live solver merges a selected detour with the native signed limit; direct 1,024 mode cases compare complete result buffers and bound state.

entries.scope: Update both wrapped quarter-cell walk bitmaps
entries.limits: Live setup and terrain edits invoke both masks using original threshold rules; harness checks mask contents and preserves active map pointer in native execution. Excludes unsupported negative radius.

entries.scope: Test native quarter-cell terrain height range against its limit
entries.limits: The standalone test wrapper and live updateWalkMasks share quarterHeightRange; direct original compares signed heights, diagonal and limits. Extra live block flags belong to the outer bitmap routine.

entries.scope: Measure a native-shaped route and flag crossed tribe regions
entries.limits: Live measure callback updates distance and tribe mask from original-shaped regions and active/recently-defeated tribe predicate. Bound to supplied region/tribe state.

entries.scope: Build the live drag-selection mesh of map-cell triangles
entries.limits: Live overlay composes native-style mesh; harness explicitly permits a browser repair for the original overwritten last triangle on seven-vertex clips.

entries.scope: Build the native-style drag selection draw queue
entries.limits: Direct oracle covers shared vertices, bucket depth and border commands; browser uses its own overlay adapter and admission, not all original rendering submissions.

entries.scope: Split live selection perimeter on cell sides and native diagonals
entries.limits: Direct oracle compares original perimeter splits and wrapped seams. Actual live overlay consumes the crossings through selection mesh; border shaders remain separate.

entries.scope: Order-focus live object resolution
entries.limits: Focus helper applies original command mask, ID, class and liveness checks; the live adapter reconstructs only selected classes from browser lists and always passes flags2 zero instead of reading the native pool object.

entries.scope: Attack approach outside the building entrance
entries.limits: Covers native entry assignment, exterior destination dispatch, facing, movement recovery and even-turn signed coordinate readiness for supported buildings. Destination/animation effect boundaries are separately supplied in the native comparison.

entries.scope: Combat approach to an already assigned strike point
entries.limits: Assignment consumption, movement recovery and even-turn signed arrival check at 112 units only; later strike and structure damage are separate. Native harness compares owned state with supplied effects.

entries.scope: Command-27 worship person controller
entries.limits: 4,096 direct comparisons cover approach, slot selection ordering, arrival, prayer animation dispatch, pose RNG, retry and flags; ordinary shared route, audio, and animation effects remain separately owned and supplied in the harness.

entries.scope: Stone Head exact standing-slot roster lookup
entries.limits: The browser uses live cell-chain order and compares exact positions, tribe, class and stationary speed, but exposes a player-tribe list from slot zero rather than the original arbitrary-tribe lookup from a caller-owned mutable slot cursor; native comparison checks isolated slot geometry and speed.

entries.scope: Object tooltip presentation
entries.limits: Forced object modes 1 and 2 are covered; first-mission lookup is approximate and modes 3–10 are unported.

entries.scope: Queued native terrain simulation passes
entries.limits: 66 native terrain states compare signed height/shore/category/cliff/shadow updates, queue cleanup and order of the two final texture consumers; those consumers are supplied in the comparison and shader/pixel parity is separate.

entries.scope: Native per-cell building placement validity
entries.limits: Oracle covers the predicate and exact feedback flags. The live adapter reconstructs scenery and does not supply native fog flags.

entries.scope: Native per-cell building shade
entries.limits: Original shade routine compared in 4,096 direct calls; supported imported rule data, not a building lifecycle claim.

entries.scope: Per-turn tribe cast cooldown and work dispatch
entries.limits: 512 direct native timer-pass cases cover land/load gates and four cooldowns; the full live CPU/territory callbacks are browser adapters, outside the timer oracle.

entries.scope: Vehicle disembark cell admissibility
entries.limits: Native terrain category and flag predicates are reconstructed and compared at this exact entry in 1,024 cases; live cell input scans active entries in the browser vehicle list, not the original object-cell chain.

entries.scope: Vehicle approach cell admissibility
entries.limits: Native shore and open-water checks are available on the live route path and compared at the exact entry in 1,024 cases, but live occupancy is an active-only browser vehicle scan.

entries.scope: Excluding yourself from vehicle cell occupancy
entries.limits: The native class-4 predicate matches the exact 1,024-case comparison, but production scans active vehicle objects from the browser list and does not traverse the original occupancy chain.

entries.scope: Vehicle readiness terrain and signed speed predicate
entries.limits: Supported registered vehicle and physics models, using native coordinate units and rule tables; 1,024 direct native predicate comparisons. Does not claim transport movement, landing or board-order parity.

entries.scope: First eligible vehicle boarding query
entries.limits: The 1,024 direct comparison cases cover cell order, signed passenger count, readiness, first passenger tribe and reservation checks; live uses active vehicle list order and derives or supplies boat availability rather than the original global.

entries.scope: First non-airborne vehicle in a path-search cell
entries.limits: The 2,048 original lookup cases cover model and class ordering, wrapped cells and the boat gate; live supplies active browser vehicles and derives availability, not the original ordered object-cell chain and global state.

entries.scope: Allocate and initialize a shared indexed XY search slot
entries.limits: Types 1 and 2 and valid native byte/word inputs; not the original callers or scheduler. Oracle compares each intermediate pool state.

entries.scope: Advance a valid indexed XY search and return the next coordinate
entries.limits: Valid allocated search IDs; compares coordinate/termination and pool state. Does not establish parity of unrelated callers.

entries.scope: Clear a valid shared indexed XY search slot
entries.limits: Valid allocated slot IDs only. Implemented for established live resting and idle approaches.

entries.scope: Wrapped square-ring cell lookup
entries.limits: 4,096 direct oracle cases cover the live 16-bit index domain, ring boundaries, coordinate wrapping and rotation behavior; not a spell-targeting parity claim.

entries.scope: Mana production meter based on sampled versus estimated demand
entries.limits: Native stripe palette and level-flag variants are exercised in focused comparisons. Live logical 640×480 geometry is separate from original resolution parameterization, and component does not supply the optional native override.

entries.scope: Shaman HUD portrait background and pose composition
entries.limits: Live canvas consumes original sprite layers and background choices. Focused original comparisons cover supplied renderer leaves and sample poses; no claim of every original HUD sprite/control state or display sizing.

entries.scope: Shaman HUD health meter fill and static frame
entries.limits: The live component renders the measured palette and fill arithmetic. Native hidden-control and per-resolution renderer branches are not implemented by the same DOM visibility and sizing mechanism.

entries.scope: Population meter fill and at-capacity flash
entries.limits: Live fill and capacity flash use the original frame mask through a scene-updated CSS value. This bounded port does not establish the original alternate tribe statistics pointer branch, native control visibility or resolution-dependent UI sizing.

entries.scope: Builder slot admission
entries.limits: Representable nonzero 16-bit person IDs and descriptor-sized slots; comparison assumes the native starting count equals occupied slots, which the browser derives. Admission alone does not establish worker eligibility or construction scheduling.

entries.scope: Stale builder-slot pruning
entries.limits: Slot pruning matches 512 oracle calls with a supplied native eligibility predicate. Live construction uses browser work-order eligibility instead.

entries.scope: Native spell range
entries.limits: 2,048 oracle cases cover range with native inputs supplied. Live building lookup and person flags derive from browser occupancy, not the original cell object and person flags.

entries.scope: Find and claim an available six-position resting slot
entries.limits: Mixed-object behavior is compared with a supplied building-outside leaf, but the live registry contains people only, so native vehicle-rest vetoes cannot participate.

entries.scope: Test availability of a resting slot
entries.limits: The helper uses terrain, occupancy and the cell-eligibility predicate. The live cell registry contains people only and cannot apply the original vehicle-rest veto.

entries.scope: Test whether a native cell permits resting
entries.limits: The helper implements land, active-order and vehicle flags, but the live adapter supplies people only, not native vehicles.

entries.scope: Rebuild and compact registered follower resting slots
entries.limits: Bounded to registered people and valid native six-slot inputs; does not establish parity for arbitrary cell object lists or all resting-state behavior.

entries.scope: Original state-3 death initializer
entries.limits: Live initializer does not dispatch state 3; the later death visit and other death logic are separate.

entries.scope: Advance the owned movement route and coordinate vehicle boarding/landing callbacks
entries.limits: Controller and ordered callback state are tested with several supplied consumers. Browser adapters own actual landing preparation, vehicle launch and task/velocity arrival, so this does not close the full native route lifecycle.

entries.scope: Check availability of the next flagged vehicle leg or final route target
entries.limits: 2,048 exact native route-record and next-cell callback comparisons with the boarding consumer supplied. Live uses the browser active-vehicle list and derived availability rather than the original cell-chain admission provider; supported route-record selection is reconstructed.

entries.scope: Native wrapped terrain drift including trough filtering
entries.limits: Models using the native falling/person-motion adapter; compared signed terrain and wrapped 16-bit coordinates, not all trajectory or scheduler behavior.

entries.scope: Native triangle slope velocity
entries.limits: Signed triangle-height inputs in the native-compatible person-motion caller; does not prove the encompassing physics visit.

entries.scope: Insert an unlinked native object at the head of its target cell
entries.limits: Valid linked-cell inputs only. Native oracle uses bounded 16-bit object table indices; browser-only handles are not a native index representation claim.

entries.scope: Detach a linked native object without rewriting its stale own links
entries.limits: Valid linked lists only. Native oracle uses bounded 16-bit indices; browser-only handles are outside the comparison.

entries.scope: Move an existing native object, with wrapped displacement and cell-list splices
entries.limits: Bounded native object table indices and signed 16-bit position/displacement. Does not cover every producer of a position or browser-only identity layout.

entries.scope: Reset native object, draw, palette and hold-clock fields using imported animation descriptors
entries.limits: Compared on imported descriptor indices and 16-bit object identifiers; not the per-frame consumer or a whole animation scheduler.

entries.scope: Pause-sensitive native two-list animation traversal
entries.limits: The two-list helper is compared using supplied morph and footprint boundaries. The live browser dispatch instead visits shrine, unit and effect arrays with split clocks; main runtime routing is not established as native allocation-list order.

entries.scope: Per-object descriptor animation clocks, pose/frame advancement and footprint trigger
entries.limits: Per-object helper is tested with loaded native tables and a hooked footprint consumer. Live callers use only scoped descriptor families, supply empty model/morph table arrays and split visit ownership; not end-to-end original dispatch.

entries.scope: Original drowning predicate
entries.limits: The predicate is implemented; this does not cover the drowning controller, death entry, or corpse update.

entries.scope: Stagger tribe territory refresh and advance the shared native search tag
entries.limits: Exact native no-hook comparison covers the stagger, wrapped tag and linked-list territory update. Live acquisition instead supplies a healthy team-filtered browser building list and a fallback defense radius outside the current campaign-tribe context.

entries.scope: Apply or clear native territory footprint bits on ground cells
entries.limits: Compared all footprint choices and overlapping removal against full 128x128 maps; live healthy-building refresh marks, and dead-building processing clears. Coverage is the footprint-bit operation, not parity of all original damage/remove producers.

entries.scope: Generate native-style sky screen-grid geometry
entries.limits: Scoped sky grid and viewport geometry; browser uses its own battlefield render surface, HUD layout and Three.js ownership, not complete native setup/state.

entries.scope: Generate sky-lens cloud vertices, fades and triangle indices
entries.limits: Sky-lens geometry is compared; browser uses Three.js meshes and shader state rather than the original D3D commands or complete blend-call sequence.

entries.scope: Update wrapped sky-camera offsets and half-angle rotation
entries.limits: Discrete helper is compared and used to initialize the sky, then continuous browser motion owns live presentation; not original per-visit timing.

entries.scope: Draw the native defeat sky quad as a browser overlay
entries.limits: Defeat branch is explicitly ported. Other sky branches use separate browser environment handling; not complete original dispatcher or D3D draw state.

entries.scope: Calculate the fixed follower-health bar border and fill
entries.limits: For eligible browser followers, the fixed 6x26 bar geometry and bounded fill are compared with native draw submissions and implemented through a precomputed atlas. Pose-scaled anchor setup, dynamic palette state and native D3D device ownership are not claimed.
